conclusion: Promote exact CK within the opt-in N1536 bucket after warm model and numerical gates. Default selection changes only; N1000 padded kernel is retained.
limitations: Warm model GPU times exclude loading, preprocessing, serialization and first-use compilation.
The CK first-build worker wall time is slower than SDPA; no cold-request wall-time speedup is claimed.
This one-input comparison establishes numerical agreement, not general structural accuracy or unmeasured model/dtype/bucket speedups.
